summary: Alliance Resource Partners LP filed an 8-K regarding a related-party Master Supply, Distribution and Services Agreement entered on July 1, 2026. The agreement is between its wholly-owned subsidiary Matrix Design Africa (PTY) LTD and Saminco Solutions LLC for non-exclusive distribution, product purchases, and services in Africa and outside the U.S. No ownership stakes, price per share, or premium are stated. The initial term is five years with auto-renewal. This is a routine master supply agreement, not a special situation.
